verdict: No unresolved blocking finding in reviewed analysis source at recorded hashes; ready for pre-inference source freeze.
scope: Read-only source/protocol review and synthetic arithmetic tests. No confirmation outcomes reviewed, no inference, no selection or model/service launch by reviewer.

closed_findings.finding: Originally analysis did not bind each measurement to the pre-inference frozen schedule or attempt freeze.
closed_findings.resolution: Main checks canonical SCHEDULE hash, every expected row metadata field and physical index, ATTEMPT.freeze_sha256, complete receipt/prediction-file hash, identical model panel identities, and frozen analyzer/protocol/helper hashes.

closed_findings.finding: Originally stored probabilities were not reconstructed from raw candidate logits.
closed_findings.resolution: Each physical row must have canonical candidate_keys, five finite logits, temperature exactly 1, and probabilities within 1e-12 of max-shifted T=1 softmax; normalization and semantic label are checked.

reviewed_properties.gate_information: Features read replica0 or replicas0+1 probabilities only. Allocation reads scores/IDs, never gold, later replicas or full-mean label. Full-mean outcomes are consulted only after fixed allocation.
reviewed_properties.paid_cost: First policy starts with one paid member; pair policies with two. Selected questions complete five total. Unique physical request membership, input tokens and recorded serial latency are summed; no free probe.
reviewed_properties.exact_budgets: For N=240 and budgets2,2.5,3,4,5: pair selected0,40,80,160,240; first selected60,90,120,180,240. Infeasible fractional allocations fail rather than round.
reviewed_properties.A_primary: Primary checkpoint qwen2.5-1.5b; primary target pair_mean_label_error; primary contrast pair_entropy_tv_rank minus pair_mean_entropy; primary metric tie-aware threshold AP. AUROC is secondary, and high score means suspected error.
reviewed_properties.A_intervals: 2000 paired whole-question bootstrap draws using fixed outcome-free cohort ranks. Percentile95 intervals are descriptive conditional estimates, with undefined draws counted. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory significance or winner claim.
reviewed_properties.B_primary: Primary checkpoint qwen2.5-1.5b; pair_entropy_tv_rank minus pair_mean_entropy accuracy at 720 paid logical calls (3N). All budgets and policies retained.
reviewed_properties.B_intervals: 2000 paired whole-question bootstrap draws of fixed chosen policy predictions; allocation is not refit in each resample. Inference is conditional on realized batch allocation, not overall policy optimality.
reviewed_properties.runtime_interpretation: Retrospective batch replay of a measured1200-call pool per model. Recorded serial latency sums are bookkeeping, not measured online wall-time or causal speedup.
reviewed_properties.source_freeze: Runner source_hashes includes confirmation analyzer/protocol/tests and exploratory analyzer/SPECIFICATION; analyzer requires actual pre-inference freeze entries for protocol, analyzer and metric helper.
reviewed_properties.freshness_limits: 517 inventory candidates are project-unused after ID and exact-question-text exclusions. This does not establish absence from pretraining or semantic independence.

boundaries: Actual study FREEZE and completed inference artifacts must still pass the runtime analyzer.
No guarantee against implementation defects outside the reviewed scope.
Any change to recorded source requires a new audit or explicit delta review before inference.
